task.description: Review REQ-004's content per docs/agents/decisions/0002 — CONTENT-BA wrote real English translations directly into messages/en.json (no CODE-DESIGNER step, per that decision). Review against content_ba_guide.md's voice/casing/vocabulary rules (same checklist used for REQ-002's Uzbek translation review), all 5 of REQ-004's acceptance criteria (see CONTENT-BA's handoff at handoffs/WF02-REQ003-REQ004/step-07-content-ba.json for the full text), and scope (only messages/en.json should have changed, no drive-by src/ edits). CONTENT-BA reports 18 of 177 values intentionally left identical to ru.json as untranslatable literals (brand names, codes, URLs, job titles already English) — spot-check a sample of these yourself to confirm they're legitimate exceptions, not missed translations.
acceptance_criteria: git diff master...HEAD reviewed directly; scoped to messages/en.json plus expected bookkeeping
Independent check that messages/en.json has no Cyrillic characters
Independent check that domain vocabulary terms use the exact stated casing/form with no synonym substitution
Independent check that status-label keys are plain lowercase English
Spot-check at least 5 of the 18 claimed-identical-to-ru.json values to confirm they're legitimate untranslatable literals, not missed translations
FAIL if a genuine violation found; otherwise PASS with any non-blocking notes

result.summary: git diff master...HEAD reviewed directly: for REQ-004's scope the only content change is new file messages/en.json (177 keys), plus expected bookkeeping (requirements.yaml status flips, requirement_status.yaml append, orchestrator.log append, handoff files); the one src/ file in the full diff (src/i18n/routing.ts) belongs to REQ-003, already reviewed and PASSed at step-02b before REQ-004's work began -- not new scope here, no drive-by src/ edits for REQ-004 itself. Independent Cyrillic grep over messages/en.json: 0 matches. Independent grep for '!'/emoji/slogans: 0 matches; read through all 12 sections' tone against content_ba_guide.md's 7 voice principles (functional, no hype, factual failure/postmortem language preserved from ru.json's equivalent). Status-label keys independently checked: Streams.stream{1-4}Status ('live'/'in progress'/'planned'/'planned') and MapSection.chapter{1-4}Status ('active'/'active'/'planned'/'planned') are all plain lowercase English, matching ru.json/uz.json's lowercase convention. Domain vocabulary (Event, Chapter, Talk, Speaker, CFP, Agenda, Check-in, Going, Watching) checked via grep across en.json: Event/Chapter/Speaker/CFP used verbatim in expected casing (Nav 'Events'/'Chapters' Title Case per nav-label convention, lowercase 'event'/'meetup'/'CFP' inline per ru.json's own casing pattern); no synonym substitution found (no 'Session' for 'Talk', no 'Registration' for 'Check-in'). Independently re-flattened both messages/en.json and messages/ru.json with a Node script and diffed all 177 leaf keys: exactly 18 identical values, matching CONTENT-BA's claimed count precisely. Spot-checked 7 of the 18 (Hero.eyebrow country/brand codes, Hero.pillUzbekistan/pillKazakhstan, Metrics.metric3Label 'NPS', Events.talk1Role 'UZ', Streams.foundationTitle 'AI Qadam Build', Team.team1Role 'Founder Global', Footer.hashtag) -- all are legitimate untranslatable literals (codes, brand/product names, acronyms, already-English job titles); corroborated by checking messages/uz.json, which independently left the same values (team4Role 'Board', metric1Source '158 + 142', foundationLink, pillUzbekistan/pillKazakhstan) identical across all three locales in the already-approved REQ-002 review, confirming these are genuine cross-locale literals and not a missed-translation pattern specific to this diff. Title Case vs sentence case spot-checked across all 'title'/CTA fields: page-title-mapping-to-domain-noun cases don't occur in this content (all 'title' fields are section taglines, correctly sentence case matching ru.json's Russian originals); CTAs (ctaPrimary/ctaSecondary/door2Link/cta) all sentence case. UPPERCASE MONO labels (pills, tab labels, node sub-labels, license/prototype footer labels) all consistently uppercase, matching ru.json's uppercase Russian equivalents. Bookkeeping files (requirement_status.yaml, orchestrator.log) diffed: both append-only (0 deletions), content consistent with the actual pipeline history observed. No violation found.
